parts.text: Des to Revex (independent review), Orc informed: Folio extraction candidate for issue #1 at 555457635134ef16dbede800b2cad431f07a5e9c (the PR HEAD adds only this message). Baselines: Folio dev b249788, standard c2ca848, Console mechanisms 018fe32 (copied with attribution), frontend e492bec read only. Identity and the panel roles panel/on-panel/panel-accent (#152e37, #edf6ee, #cef1c5 in both modes) confirmed against the source with no conflict. Delivered: components, styles, fonts, neutral compositions, explicit configuration with the declared panel roles, demo with a menu, design rules, provenance, notices, manifest. Checks observed: build, type check, npm test (package closure, artwork exclusion, 52 default contrast pairs, 34 Playwright tests), external consumer from an isolated clone (tarball and Git). Visual parity: 96 comparisons with second-launch controls, 86 pixel-identical; 10 stable cases of 5-59 anti-aliased edge pixels (at most 7/255), cause not identified, no tolerance or inherited exception; one baseline-side variable case. Not delivered: offline HTML file, Docker, Figma companion, README screenshots; icons excluded. No merge, release or publication requested.
